modules.name: 3 players: lone wizard vs allies (Velké rozšíření)
Solo vs the Cave Lord (Velké rozšíření)

steps.text: Each player shuffles a 13-card starting deck (black star): Sword, Shield, Blessing, Magic Dart, Crystal Ball, Magic Stone, Small Curse, Small Library, Secret Potion, Freeze, Skeleton, Healer, Fireball
steps.note: One of each; the bracketed numbers in the rules are card values

steps.text: Each player picks a grey-framed wizard card (robe color has no effect) and puts the "Wizard - level 1" card next to it
{n} life tokens on your level card (also your maximum)
steps.note: 3 players (lone wizard): the lone wizard gets 1 more

steps.text: Other wizard cards for the other magic colors set aside; life, curse, magic and freeze tokens as a shared supply
All other numbered cards (not starting decks) shuffled as the shop deck; 6 faceup as the shop offer
steps.note: Solo: build the shop from base-game cards only

steps.text: The Cave Lord is a level-2 wizard with 8 lives and its magic color; track both on the counters, level cards under them so only curse and abilities show
You start at level 1 with 7 lives, with Small Library already played and 5 cards in hand
Difficulty: 1 buy up to value 15, 2 up to 10, 3 up to 5, 4 starting deck only, 5 also Cave Lord only damageable once its deck is out, 6 plus it heals 1 each round
steps.note: Before the game you buy normally with 3 magic (plus 1 per magic and swap up to 2 shop cards); shuffle buys into your deck

steps.text: Chest card: choose side A or B and 1-3 lives for it
Magic income: 1 per round in the standard game
Allies share a common heart, may heal and add lives to each other and gain +2 or +3 magic
Allies have separate lives; once one is out, it becomes a 2-player game
You may attack any opponent; out at 0 lives
Solo: 1 magic per round; the Cave Lord plays 3 cards the first round, then 2
Agree on a starting player: they draw 3 cards, the other draws 5; from round 2 always 5
Everyone draws 3 for the first round (the lone wizard plays 2 rounds with 3), then 5
Everyone draws 3 for the first round (the lone wizard plays 2 rounds with 3), then 5
Agree on a turn order; everyone draws 3 for the first round, then 5
